Container.Name: novacortex-redis
Container.Overview:
Redis preconfigured as the session and rate-limit cache for the NovaCortex stack. Redis itself is by Redis Ltd; this template is maintained by Nova Cognitive Systems, and support below goes to the NovaCortex issue tracker.
Part 1 of a 5-container stack. Install in this order, all on the same Docker network:
0. Create the shared network once, from an Unraid terminal: docker network create novacortex Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network, which is how the API finds this container by the name "novacortex-redis". 1. novacortex-redis (this template) 2. novacortex-surrealdb 3. novacortex-qdrant 4. novacortex-api 5. novacortex-web
Prefer one click to five? Install the whole stack with the Docker Compose Manager plugin instead — see templates/unraid/README.md in the project repository. Both paths are supported and produce the same container names.
Notes for this container: - Set a password below. It is required: the novacortex-api template needs it inside REDIS_URL as redis://:YOUR-PASSWORD@novacortex-redis:6379, and Redis refuses remote commands when no password is configured. - It publishes no ports, so only containers on the novacortex network can reach it. - You do not need to chown the appdata folder. The image starts as root purely to hand /data to its own unprivileged redis user (uid 999) and then drops to it. That is also why the data path has to be on the array: the Unraid boot flash is FAT32 and has no Unix ownership, so this container restart-loops if you point it there.
Container.Description: Redis is an in-memory data store. NovaCortex uses it for API sessions and rate-limit counters, not for memory data — losing this volume costs you active sessions and nothing else. It is configured here exactly as in the supported Compose stack: append-only persistence on, capped at 256 MB with an allkeys-lru eviction policy, and password-protected.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex). Only useful together with the rest of the NovaCortex stack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: novacortex redis cache sessions rate-limit mcp self-hosted agents

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Where Redis keeps its append-only file. Must be an absolute path on the array or a pool — the FAT32 boot flash cannot hold it.

Config.Name: Redis Password
Config.Description: Required. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24 — then use the identical value in the novacortex-api template's REDIS_URL, as redis://:YOUR-PASSWORD@novacortex-redis:6379
